newsitem.title: USA: Champion committed to 20 pct EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Champion committed to 20 pct EPS growth.

text.p: Champion Enterprises said Wednesday it remains committed to achieving its three-year goal of increasing earnings per share by 20 percent annally, excluding extraordinary items.
The manufactured home producer said its 1996 earnings excluding merger charges rose 25 percent to $70.3 million, or $1.43 a share, from $56.3 million, or $1.14 a share, in 1995.

Including a one-time fourth quarter charge of $16.7 million, or $0.34 a share, associated with the acquisition of Redman Industries Inc, Champion's 1996 net income came to $53.6 million, or $1.09 a share.
